I bought this to replace the broken door switch on my Whirlpool Cabrio dryer, Model WGD5600XW0. The hardest part was opening the top of my dryer. After that it was as easy as plug in the new switch, screw it in place with the two existing screws, close the lid, and plug in the dryer. As shown in the attached photo, the light now comes on when the door is open. It works just like the OEM version and it cost less than $8 and not even 5 minutes of effort. Highly recommend for DIY lovers.
